      "content_utf8": "# Independent mathematical review: RR4B public seed externalization

2026-10-14. Reviewer `EM-NONAUTHOR-5DF3A9B6`, continuing own activity
`RA-MATH-NONAUTHOR-5DF3A9B61C7D4BE6BEE0`. Directed NONBLIND support,
not a Native Driver review, acceptance, intake decision or authority repair.
The original Task, publication, claim and mathematical owner are unchanged.
Root remains the formal Driver and sole Source writer.

Exact object: `RR-4B7576B2FDCA2CCBAB37`, Task
`RS-N-COUPLED-PUBLIC-N-REALIZED-EFFECT-TRACE-NONCOMPILABILITY`, publication
`TP2-6E2A94C1B7D3058F2A41`, scientific author `EM-NCASEFF1-84C2D6`.
The eight complete input originals are pinned at Source
`392779696b036299fc7a631b1dd71a59229566dd` in the accompanying fullpin
manifest. The current Taskbook was additionally read in full through the
connected GitHub tool at immutable commit
`44270717b3b983a892beb5b0da785afd423ef78c`; its blob remains
`243efaef4fb6e0b9f2faad08a6c8397ee5be844b` and its SHA256 remains
`0b08d38e8908518a1787bdefa23146e3bb5c0daaddf963947fd54284633631ae`.

**Disposition: PASS / exact task-local negative boundary for the frozen
G_effect-seed model.** The symbolic seed-externalization proof is correct
under its literal finite public-sampler/public-compiler semantics. The
scalar witness really hides the actual support branch while reducing
exactly to explicit uniform scalar-presentation sampling and gcd readout.
This is an alternative expressly permitted by the operative Taskbook.
No mathematical amendment is necessary for that bounded disposition.
This does not establish an impossibility theorem for arbitrary realized
effects or complete the parent objective.

## 1. Identity, exposure and evidence method

The Result, ER, effect contract and certificate consistently identify the
scientific author as EM-NCASEFF1-84C2D6. The publication identifies its
publisher as EM-DVR-P8H4Q2. Neither is my identity or an identity under
which I made a contribution. My only continuing reviewer identity here
is EM-NONAUTHOR-5DF3A9B6. I did not author this calculus, witness, seed
theorem, checker or historical result. I previously reviewed RR65 as
support; that does not make me an author of RR4B or supply it with review
authority. Root's shared control context and the old result's identity and
summary were visible. This is a directed NONBLIND review, not a blind one.

I read in full the Taskbook, return, exact contract, certificate, checker
source, Result, publication and ER. I independently checked the proof
below. All eight actual local byte strings match the lengths, SHA256 and
Git blobs in the Source392 recovery matrix. The five Result manifest
entries match the four scientific outputs and ER; the ER's four frozen
output pins match those same scientific outputs. I reused the existing
actual Source392 readback/tree custody evidence and made the additional
current immutable Taskbook read stated above. These checks establish
which bytes were reviewed, not their mathematical truth or historical
execution authenticity.

I did not read or adopt an old DR as a mathematical or authority decision.
The Taskbook contains historical DR identifiers as lineage text; their
appearance is not acceptance evidence. I did not execute, import or
replay the old scientific checker, run its enumerations, instantiate any
prime or sample, or perform Hart work. The integer count totals below
were checked by symbolic counting and ordinary hand arithmetic, not by
rerunning the finite experiment. No new owner, Task, claim or branch is
created by this support review.

## 2. The operative Task permits this negative alternative

The hard target is the frozen realized-effect capability constructed or
exactly obstructed. The Taskbook explicitly asks whether hidden randomness
or nondeterminism can be pushed forward to an effectively sampleable or
enumerable family of explicit presentations. If so, and successful readout
is a proper presentation-gcd/nonunit event, it directs classification as
randomized nonunit search. Its valid-negative criteria separately allow
public presentation compilation, explicit randomized presentation/nonunit
equivalence, or another reviewed mechanism.

Thus the return need not prove that the actual branch is determined by
the public transcript. Demonstrating actual-branch opacity and then proving
exact distributional externalization is an allowed discriminating outcome.
The Result's negative terminal wording is correctly restricted to its
frozen G_effect-seed class. It does not silently replace the Task's positive
requirements with a weaker positive success.

In particular the negative result does not need to establish that every
possible public scalar computation is gcd-clean, or that its witness
satisfies all five positive requirements. It identifies a decisive exact
failure of the proposed positive route under the Task's stated kill rule.
The public-N-only input discipline and non-oracle materialization still
matter to the claimed classification and are checked below.

## 3. What the frozen semantics actually grants

Each input handle denotes a finite presented R_N-module. The deterministic
constructors have public, literal presentation compilers. Each effect has
a finite seed space, a stated exact public law or effective exact public
sampler, and a public deterministic branch compiler

    Phi(N,s,C_1,...,C_k)=C'.

The runtime rule samples the stated law and computes that same Phi from
the retained input presentations. It hides the realized seed and output
presentation from the handle observer. This defines an actual distribution
on literal presentation descriptors, not just an unspecified isomorphism
class. The external construction must maintain the same marked/literal
presentation convention through the deterministic constructors and Phi.
An effect that secretly changes basis or reads extra state not supplied
to its public branch compiler is outside this contract.

The public seed sampler and branch compiler must be effective and have
the specified semantics. A public name for an oracle, an uncomputable
measure or a compiler using hidden factors does not meet that requirement.
The frozen class also forbids factor-correlated secret input, CRT selectors
and secret implementation. Its claim is a computability/pushforward normal
form; it supplies no polynomial-time or resource overhead bound for the
external simulator. A very expensive public branch compiler remains very
expensive after externalization.

The sampling rule is the conditional transition rule at each invocation:
the seed is drawn from its stated public law before the same Phi is run.
Equality of marginal seed laws alone would not suffice if an implementation
used hidden cross-event correlations, persistent secret seeds or secret
state-dependent conditioning. Such behavior is not licensed by this literal
rule. The proof does not extend to it merely because each individual seed
has a publicly known marginal distribution.

## 4. Theorem A preserves the full joint law

Initially the public-N program's constructed input presentations are known
to the external compiler. Order the finite program's constructor/effect
events along its declared execution order. Assuming equality of the joint
law of the retained input-presentation state before an event, a deterministic
presentation-transparent constructor applies the same explicit map to both
states and preserves equality.

For an effect, condition on the entire retained input tuple, rather than
only on the separate marginal law of each handle. Both executions sample
the same specified conditional seed law and apply the same Phi to that
tuple. Therefore their conditional law of the output and retained state
is identical. Integrating over the already equal joint input law proves
the induction step. Repeating over the finite event list preserves the
complete joint presentation-trace law. Consuming handles changes resource
availability but adds no extra random input or hidden branch map.

Equivalently, for integer seed weights with total W>0, the mass of any
output C is the sum of weights of all seeds whose compiled output is C,
divided by W. Different seeds may compile to the same C; the proof sums
their mass and does not presume injectivity. Repeated effects require
the joint-state induction above, not independent simulation of output
marginals. The supplied proof correctly uses the joint tuple.

Applying the same deterministic terminal readout R(N,C_final) to the
two identical presentation laws gives identical readout laws. This does
not couple an independent external sample to the particular seed of the
original run. It reproduces the law, not guaranteed knowledge of that
run's realized outcome. There is no contradiction with branch opacity.

The statement is for the frozen finite, effective seeded program and its
specified readout. It is not a theorem for arbitrary nondeterministic
schedulers, unbounded or divergent executions, hidden correlations or a
terminal oracle that depends on unrepresented private history. Those are
not admitted by silently treating a public seed marginal as a full public
transition specification.

## 5. The scalar witness crosses the actual-branch boundary

For N=pq with distinct primes, tensoring H_A=coker([A]) with F_ell
gives the cokernel of the scalar A modulo ell. This uses right exactness
of tensor; it needs no flatness hypothesis. The cokernel over F_ell is
one-dimensional exactly when ell divides A and is zero otherwise.

Thus gcd(N,A) is exactly the product of the supported primes. The
squarefree two-prime premise is essential to this literal support-product
statement; no prime-power multiplicity assertion is inferred.

All four choices A=1,p,q,0 are residues of the same publicly defined
uniform seed space and have positive probability. They give, respectively,
empty, p-only, q-only and two-prime support under one public pre-readout
transcript. A compiler receiving only that transcript and N has the same
input on these runs and cannot deterministically identify the support of
every run. This is already true of support, not merely of a presentation
that might differ while presenting an isomorphic module.

The p and q choices are existential proof witnesses inside the uniform
residue space; they are not inputs or a procedure for choosing a factor.
The runtime samples A uniformly using N only. No secret factor, supplied
CRT side or chosen nonunit has been inserted into the effect definition.
The noncompilability proved here is failure of actual-branch determination
from the stated observation. It is not a Turing uncomputability or factoring
complexity lower bound. Another independent sample can reproduce the
distribution without determining the first sample.

Terminal materialization returns the actual presentation [A]. Under the
frozen contract this is an explicitly granted terminal operation, distinct
from a primitive directly specified to return a factor or CRT support bit.
Its presence does not rescue the witness from the randomized-search kill
rule: once materialization supplies [A], the declared readout is gcd(N,A).

## 6. The exact distributional classification is justified

Sampling A uniformly in the same public residue set and forming the scalar
matrix [A] externally produces exactly the same law as the hidden effect.
The readout therefore has the same distribution branch for branch. CRT
counting gives:

- gcd1: both field coordinates nonzero, hence (p-1)(q-1) residues;
- gcdp: the p coordinate zero and the q coordinate nonzero, hence q-1;
- gcdq: the q coordinate zero and the p coordinate nonzero, hence p-1;
- gcdN: both zero, hence the single residue A=0.

The counts sum to pq. The proper-factor event has p+q-2 residues and
probability (p+q-2)/(pq), with A=0 correctly excluded from proper success.
This covers distinct primes including the case one is2 without a separate
experiment or an odd-prime assumption.

Accordingly the witness is exactly explicit uniform scalar sampling plus
gcd; it is not only analogous to that mechanism. For the broader frozen
class, Theorem A likewise yields explicit presentation sampling followed
by the same support-bearing determinantal/nonunit readout whenever that
is the specified success criterion. The previous presentation-support
theorem supplies the readout interpretation; this return does not infer
it from probabilities or from a new native information principle.

The general normal form need not be a single uniformly random scalar
sample: its seed law and final presentations may be complicated. The
precise broad claim is an external explicit-presentation sampler with the
same readout law. The direct one-scalar count and probability belong only
to G_effect-randrel. No universal trial count, efficient compiler or cost
lower bound follows from the equivalence.

## 7. Static checker assessment and execution boundary

The old checker exhausts scalar residues for unordered distinct pairs
from eight listed primes, and checks the support/count formulas. Its
reported totals are arithmetically consistent: 28 pairs; the prime sum
is77 and square sum1027, giving (77^2-1027)/2=2451 scalar branches;
the proper-support total is7*77-2*28=483. Five biases per pair give
140 weighted regressions, in addition to28 uniform cases.

I obtained those identities from the loop bounds and counting formulas,
not by executing the loops. The historical ER and certificate report
zero mismatches and a PASS stdout; this review has not independently
replayed or authenticated that historical execution.

The uniform pushforward functions encode the same identity seed compiler
in two simple forms. More significantly, the weighted hidden and external
pushforward functions have identical code. Their equality is therefore
only a regression of the declared model and arithmetic bookkeeping; it
is not an independent implementation test of hidden-runtime semantics.
The return correctly places the symbolic induction, not these finite
tests or their hit rates, in the role of proof. This limitation requires
no mathematical amendment for the present bounded PASS.

The ER's legacy record_id spelling and absent taskbook_blob_sha1 are
control/provenance issues. They do not invalidate the explicit algebra,
but mathematical review does not repair them or restore historical
execution authority. The contract-only PR1551 is outside this proof;
neither its preparation nor any later merge supplies mathematical truth,
a new research authorization or a reason to suspend this independent
assessment. Formal intake and Driver decisions remain with Root.

## 8. Exact remaining boundary and observer typing

This result rejects the claimed new support capability for the frozen
class with a complete public effective seed/presentation pushforward.
It does not prove that every fully specified effect has such a pushforward,
or that every actual-source mechanism is impossible. A successor must
specify any different resource and its entire public conditional semantics
and terminal readout, rather than merely conceal an ordinary random seed.

The stated remaining possibility of a public-N, non-oracular effect with
nonexternalizable semantics is an open question and a selection criterion,
not an exhibited construction or a proved feasible computational model.
This review starts no successor and claims no novelty, working truth,
foundation/canonical promotion, factoring lower bound or parent completion.

All R_N modules, probability laws and support observations here are external
finite typed mathematical observers on the retained labelled state over a
native Heartbeat X6 Cell under the previously read P000/Heartbeat/joint-
relation foundations. Event order in the simulated program does not define
a new native spatial axis or physical time. Distributional equality in this
external model is not completeness of a native projection, full-X6
propagation or a native information lower bound.

This review and its fullpin manifest are ready for Root's formal Driver
assessment and Source publication. They create no Native review record
and make no remote mutation or own-RA event for RR4B before its actual
review Source is published.
